import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import os
import warnings
import gc
import time
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import lightgbm as lgb

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

start_time = time.time()

# Load data
print("Loading data...")
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test_df.shape}")

# Split train into train/validation (80/20 holdout)
train_idx, val_idx = train_test_split(
    train_df.index, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=train_df["target"]
)
train_data = train_df.loc[train_idx].copy()
val_data = train_df.loc[val_idx].copy()

# Separate features and target
X_train = train_data.drop(["id", "target"], axis=1).copy()
y_train = train_data["target"].values.astype(np.float32)
X_val = val_data.drop(["id", "target"], axis=1).copy()
y_val = val_data["target"].values.astype(np.float32)

# Prepare features and test set
X_test = test_df.drop("id", axis=1).copy()

# Convert categorical columns to LightGBM format using category dtype
categorical_features = ["f_27"]
X_train[categorical_features] = X_train[categorical_features].astype("category")
X_val[categorical_features] = X_val[categorical_features].astype("category")
X_test[categorical_features] = X_test[categorical_features].astype("category")

feature_cols = [c for c in X_train.columns]

# Create LightGBM datasets with categorical features specified
train_data_lgb = lgb.Dataset(
    X_train[feature_cols], label=y_train, categorical_feature=categorical_features
)
val_data_lgb = lgb.Dataset(
    X_val[feature_cols],
    label=y_val,
    reference=train_data_lgb,
    categorical_feature=categorical_features,
)

# Define parameters with updated num_boost_round for faster training
lgb_params = {
    "objective": "binary",
    "metric": "auc",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "num_leaves": 31,
    "learning_rate": 0.1,
    "feature_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "verbose": -1,
    "n_jobs": -1,
    "seed": 42,
    "min_data_in_leaf": 20,
    "max_depth": 6,
    "cat_smooth": 1.0,
    "early_stopping_rounds": 100,
    "num_boost_round": 1000,
}

# Train model with early stopping
print("Training LightGBM model...")
model = lgb.train(
    lgb_params,
    train_data_lgb,
    valid_sets=[val_data_lgb],
    callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=100, verbose=False)],
)

# Evaluate on validation set
y_val_pred = model.predict(X_val[feature_cols], num_iteration=model.best_iteration)
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, y_val_pred)
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC: {val_auc:.6f}")

# Generate submission on test set
print("Generating submission...")
test_preds = model.predict(X_test[feature_cols], num_iteration=model.best_iteration)

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

submission_df = pd.DataFrame({"id": test_df["id"], "target": test_preds})
submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")

elapsed_time = time.time() - start_time
print(f"\nTotal elapsed time: {elapsed_time:.2f} seconds")
print(f"Final Validation AUC-ROC Score: {val_auc}")
